Condition Stimulus
Training item Esta cadeira é cor-de-laranja. this chair is orange This chair is orange
7b.Training item E mesa é amarela. and the table is yellow And the table is yellow.
2 Training item apontando para 0 pato) Este é um pato. this is a duck (pointing at the duck) This one is a duck.
3 . Training item apontando para 0 cão) Este é 0 this here is the cat (pointing at the dog) This one here is the cat. aqui gato.
Adjunct menino está a saltar na mesa the is PREP jump-INF on+the table The is jumping on the table: boy boy
5. Subject A mãe está a limpar a the mother is PREP clean-INF the table 'The mother is cleaning the table.
6 Control A mãe está a pentear 0 bebé. the mother is PREP comb-INF the baby The mother is combing the baby's hair
7. Direct object cão está a morder sapato. the is PREP bite-INF the shoe. The is biting the shoe. dog dog
8 Dative 0 menino está a mostrar desenho ao the is PREP show-INF the drawing to+the cat 'The is showing the drawing to the cat. gato. boy boy
9. Adjunct 0 bebé está a tomar banho com 0 the baby is PREP take-INF bath with the cat gato.
10. Direct object A mãe está a lavar the mother is PREP bathe-INF the cat The mother is bathing the_cat. gato.
11. Control menino está a molhar the is PREP wet-INF the cat The is wetting the cat. gato. boy boy
12. Subject A menina está a molhar cão. the girl is PREP wet-INF the The is wetting the dog_ dog girl
13. Direct object A menina está a comer the girl is PREP eat-INF the apple The is eating the macã. girl apple
14. Adjunct a banana na cadeira. the banana on+the chair banana on the chair.’
